description: This file defines a Grain class in Orleans that subscribes to a stream and implements a call filter for intercepting incoming calls, primarily used for testing stream interception behavior.

classes.name: StreamInterceptionGrain
classes.description: A Grain that subscribes to a specified stream and overrides activation logic to set up stream subscription and implements an incoming call filter for testing stream behavior.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation to set up stream subscription and initialize internal state.

methods.name: GetLastStreamValue
methods.description: Returns the last value received from the stream.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Implements the IIncomingGrainCallFilter interface method to intercept incoming grain calls and modify internal state based on stream updates for testing purposes.
